quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to greet the day with a big stretch and a smile"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: Your eyes open, and a brand new day is waiting for you.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waking up is the very first step of our morning routine.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Anytime to keep your hands clean after playing outside"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: Soap, water, and a good scrub are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our hands to keep sneaky germs away.
quests.funFact: Clean hands are one of the best ways to stay healthy and strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to change out of pajamas and into daytime clothes"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: You do this right after breakfast, before you leave home.
quests.explanation: Yes! We get dressed in the morning before we head out for the day.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed super fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to wash away the whole day's dirt and dust"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: This washes away the whole day's dirt in one splash.
quests.explanation: Correct! We take a bath in the evening to get ready for a cozy night's sleep.
quests.funFact: Bath time is a great time to sing a silly song while you splash!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to hang your bag up neatly after you get to class"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: This keeps your bag safe and out of the way during class.
quests.explanation: Well done! A backpack on its hook keeps our classroom tidy.
quests.funFact: A tidy hook area makes it easy to grab your backpack again after school!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to clear away dust and crumbs with a broom"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: This leaves the floor looking neat and clean.
quests.explanation: Well done! A swept floor looks neat and feels clean under your feet.
quests.funFact: A broom's long bristles can reach into corners that are hard to clean!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to soak the soil where outdoor plants are growing"?
quests.question: Water the Garden
quests.hint: This is for plants growing outside in the ground, not in small pots indoors.
quests.explanation: Yes! We water the garden so outdoor plants can grow big and healthy.
quests.funFact: Gardens can grow colorful flowers and tasty vegetables with enough water and sunshine!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to practice today's lesson a little more at home"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: This helps you practice what you learned that day in class.
quests.explanation: Well done! Finishing homework helps us feel ready for the next school day.
quests.funFact: Doing a little homework each day can help new lessons stick in your memory!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to search a laundry pile for two socks that match"?
quests.question: Match Your Socks
quests.hint: This is a matching puzzle you solve with clean laundry.
quests.explanation: Yes! We match socks together after they come out of the laundry.
quests.funFact: Some families keep a special basket just for socks that are still looking for their pair!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to care for a plant sitting near the window"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: Plants need this to stay green and grow strong.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watering plants means giving them a drink so they can grow.
quests.funFact: Some houseplants only need a little water once or twice a week!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Afternoon to neatly stack clean clothes after they dry"?
quests.question: Fold the Laundry
quests.hint: This happens after clothes come out of the dryer or off the line.
quests.explanation: That's right! Folding laundry means smoothing and stacking clean clothes neatly.
quests.funFact: Folding laundry as a family can make the chore go by much faster!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to make the carpet spotless with a humming machine"?
quests.question: Vacuum the Floor
quests.hint: This machine makes a humming sound as it cleans.
quests.explanation: Yes! We vacuum the floor to clean dust and crumbs from the carpet.
quests.funFact: Vacuuming regularly can help keep dust from building up around your home!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to enjoy a quick treat like fruit or crackers"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: Fruit, crackers, or cheese are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A snack is a small, tasty bite between meals.
quests.funFact: Fruits like apples and grapes make a healthy and tasty afternoon snack!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to enjoy the very first meal of the day"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: This is the very first meal you eat each day.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat breakfast in the morning to get energy for the day.
quests.funFact: Breakfast is often called the most important meal because it fuels your whole morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to get the table ready before everyone sits down to eat"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: Plates, cups, and forks are placed down for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We set the table before dinner so everyone can sit and eat.
quests.funFact: Some families like to fold napkins into fun shapes when setting the table!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to lace up before you leave the house"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Your feet need this before running, walking, or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on shoes is one of the last steps before we leave home.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right shoes helps keep your feet safe while you run and play!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to form a neat row before walking inside together"?
quests.question: Line Up for Class
quests.hint: A neat row, not a crowd, is the goal for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Lining up helps our whole class walk inside safely together.
quests.funFact: Many classrooms line up the same way every single morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to give a cheerful wave before heading off to school"?
quests.question: Wave Goodbye
quests.hint: A smile often comes along with this friendly gesture.
quests.explanation: Well done! A cheerful wave is a warm way to start the school day.
quests.funFact: A cheerful goodbye can help everyone feel happy as the day begins!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to cover your toes before your shoes go on"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: Your toes stay warm and cozy because of this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on socks comes right before putting on our shoes.
quests.funFact: Matching two socks together can be a fun little puzzle every morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to get snuggly and warm before bed"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: These clothes are soft, comfy, and just for sleeping.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on pajamas at night to get cozy before bed.
quests.funFact: Many pajamas are covered in fun patterns like stars, stripes, or favorite animals!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to make sure your animal friend has food and water"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: A food bowl and a happy, hungry pet are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We feed the pet in the morning so it has food for the day.
quests.funFact: Many pets look forward to feeding time as one of the best parts of their day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to choose the time your morning will begin"?
quests.question: Set an Alarm
quests.hint: This helps you wake up at just the right time tomorrow.
quests.explanation: That's right! Setting an alarm means choosing the time we want to wake up.
quests.funFact: The very first alarm clocks were invented so people wouldn't oversleep for work!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to stand patiently at your spot before school"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
quests.hint: You stand at a special sign or stop for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wait for the bus at our stop before it arrives.
quests.funFact: Standing back from the curb while you wait helps keep you safe until the bus arrives!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to pack clothes just right for jumping and playing games"?
quests.question: Pack Your Gym Clothes
quests.hint: Sneakers and comfy, stretchy clothes go inside your bag for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack gym clothes for an active class full of running and games.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right gym clothes can make exercise class much more comfortable!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to carry out the trash before it gets too full"?
quests.question: Empty the Trash
quests.hint: A bag or bin gets carried outside for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We empty the trash once the bin at home gets full.
quests.funFact: Many neighborhoods have a special collection day just for household trash!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to add crunchy flakes to a bowl for breakfast"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: You do this before you sit down to eat breakfast.
quests.explanation: Well done! A bowl of cereal with milk makes a tasty morning meal.
quests.funFact: Whole grain cereals can give you energy that lasts through your whole morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to rinse away food from plates and bowls"?
quests.question: Wash the Dishes
quests.hint: Plates and cups become sparkly clean because of this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Clean dishes are ready to use again at the next meal.
quests.funFact: Some families take turns washing the dishes to help each other out!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to remove empty dishes once the meal is finished"?
quests.question: Clear the Table
quests.hint: This is the opposite of setting the table.
quests.explanation: Well done! A cleared table is ready to be wiped clean.
quests.funFact: Setting and clearing the table are two halves of the very same mealtime routine!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to sit at the table and eat something yummy"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: You often sit at a table with your family for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat dinner in the evening to enjoy a warm meal together.
quests.funFact: Sharing a meal together is a lovely time to talk about your favorite part of the day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to enjoy a short cartoon before bedtime gets close"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: A screen and a comfy couch are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We watch a little TV in the evening to relax.
quests.funFact: Balancing TV time with playing and reading helps keep your evening varied and fun!
